text.p: -- Montgomery Securities Analyst Jonathan Joseph raised his rating on Integrated Device Technology Inc to BUY from HOLD. Further details were not available.

-- In a research report Joseph said Integrated's order growth this quarter is much stronger than expected with orders for the first two months of the atr about equal with the September qtr's total orders, which were about $120 million and generated a book to bill ratio of about 1.0
-- Notes order growth could rise more than 30 pct qtr to qtr.
-- Joseph raised fiscal 1997 estimate to a profit of $0.01/shr from a loss $0.08 and raised fiscal 1998 to a profit of $0.60/shr from a profit of $0.16/shr.
